endorsements.name: Joe Damato
endorsements.label: Function Hooking for Mac OSX and Linux
endorsements.description: This talk will cover three different methods of function hooking for Mac OSX and Linux. The talk will begin by describing useful bits of Intel64 assembly followed up with 3 different binary rewriting techniques to hook a range of different functions, including some inlined functions, too. We'll finish up with a demo of two nice things that these techniques make possible (a memory profiler and a function call tracer), and one slightly more evil thing.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 18
